title: Michigan swamp gas case

tellings.quote: Michigan swamp gas. Uh you also see large disc-like objects.

plain: The researcher Marik von Rennenkampff brings up the Michigan sightings that were famously explained away as "swamp gas", gas rising from marshes, and says that in such cases you also see large disc-like objects. He mentions it in passing, without a source, during a debate with a UFO skeptic. He raises it as an example of a sighting whose official explanation does not fit what was reported.
